notes.title: Locks Quest Update LIVE (June 16th 2017)
notes.content:
Increased mouse collider size on the enemies to make it easier to target them.
Increased size of the mini-game UI elements to make it easier to use with the mouse.
Increased the fail timer on the mini-games.
Improvements made to the targeting system for turrets.
All mini-games now have alternative keyboard versions;
 
- Attack Buff mini-game : Press the number keys in the order shown.
- Repair mini-game : Use the left and right arrow keys to ratchet.
- Poison mini-game : Use the left and right arrow keys to rotate the wheel.
- Vampire Drain mini-game : User the left and right arrow keys to move the slider.
- Freeze mini-game : Use the up and down arrow keys to move the tabs.
 
Repair and Poison mini-games can also be played using the mouse scroll wheel.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 10 lower-profile new Steam games
notes.content:
New feature! There are more new PC games released each week than any one human could realistically play, and while we try to zero in on the most interesting, many lovely things inevitably fall through the cracks. So here’s the deal: each week, I browse the teeming ranks of Steam (we’ll also be including itch.io a little later, incidentally) for ten likely prospects released within the past seven days. I play each for ten minutes, then decide whether or not I’d like to keep playing them. It’s not a review, but it is, but it isn’t, but maybe? In any case: new games for good people. That’s you, that is.

Update: this piece now includes (as it will every time henceforth) my Pick Of The Week from the ten games included.
… [visit site to read more]
